description: CR 612.1 a hacked Crasher reads ISLANDS and alice's own Island frees it
note: Glacial Crasher "can't attack unless there is a Mountain on the battlefield" names a basic land type in its CR 508.1c gate, and the gate reads the whole battlefield, so the swap is the only thing under test. alice holds a Magical Hack and the Island that pays for it; bob has no creature. With no Mountain anywhere, Mountain -> Island on the Crasher makes alice's own Island satisfy the rewritten gate, so the Crasher is offered and attacks.
